title: Nine

description: A corporate downsizing expert (George Clooney) realizes he is developing real feelings for a frequent bedmate (Vera Farmiga) whose cache of travel miles and club cards rivals his own.

description: A Navy admiral (Gene Hackman) orders the rescue of a fighter pilot (Owen Wilson) after the Serbs shoot down his plane in Bosnia.

description: Some of the servicemen who raised the U.S. flag on Mount Suribachi during the Battle of Iwo Jima at the end of World War II live to hear of their status as heroes.

description: A meticulous detective and the young officer about to replace the veteran probe serial murders based on the seven deadly sins.

title: Grumpy Old Men
description: Minnesota neighbors (Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau) rekindle a 10-year feud when they fall for the same widow (Ann-Margret).

title: The Manchurian Candidate
description: A troubled Gulf War veteran (Denzel Washington) becomes suspicious after a powerful senator's (Meryl Streep) son (Liev Schreiber) becomes a candidate for vice president.

title: Rock of Ages
description: Songs by Def Leppard, Journey, Joan Jett, Bon Jovi and others underscore a rock 'n' roll romance between a small-town girl (Julianne Hough) and a city boy (Diego Boneta) who meet on the Sunset Strip while chasing their Hollywood dreams.

title: Ghost in the Shell
description: A one-of-a-kind, cyber-enhanced soldier (Scarlett Johansson) must battle a new enemy who can hack into people's minds and control them.

title: Baby Driver
description: Coerced into working for a crime boss, a talented getaway driver must face the music when a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

title: Molly's Game
description: Molly Bloom runs the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested by the FBI. Her only ally is defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learns that there is much more to Molly than the tabloids lead people to believe.
